case.title: Pump housing PH-100: the foundry wants +8.8 %
case.briefing: Demo Gießerei GmbH, our single source for the grey-iron pump housing PH-100 for 12 years, announces +8.8 % from 1 December citing energy and wages. Castings are a strategic category: the goal is to stabilise supply with a healthy partner, so squeezing the foundry below a 4 % margin costs us (from EUR 5,000 per margin point and year). We need 4,000 housings a year for the next two years; anything not covered by this deal costs EUR 55.00 per unit (spot buys and a second source). Price, payment terms, contract length and the date the new price applies are open; lead time and Incoterm are fixed.

messages.subject: Quote from Demo Gießerei GmbH: Pump housing PH-100: the foundry wants +8.8 %
messages.body:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

It is always a pleasure to work with your esteemed house, continuing the strong tradition of craftsmanship and trust between our companies. For this agreement, our offer stands at a price of €52.90 per unit, a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, valid from 1 December 2026. 

To remain transparent about our situation, WAGES-METAL rose 3.1 % in twelve months and is 28 % of our cost. We take great pride in the dedication of our foundry workforce and the quality we deliver to our partners every day.

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. We look forward to continuing our successful cooperation together.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Demo Gießerei GmbH: Pump housing PH-100: the foundry wants +8.8 %
messages.body:
Dear Mr Moser,

Thank you for your offer and your kind words. We value our cooperation just as much, and we appreciate your openness about the wage increases in metalworking and the pride you take in your foundry team.

We have reviewed your proposal carefully. While we understand the pressure from wages, we cannot follow the increase as offered. Instead, we would like to propose a longer partnership that gives you planning security:

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 46.80; payment 60 days net; contract term 24 months; new price valid from 2026-12-01.
Option B: unit price EUR 45.43; payment 45 days net; contract term 24 months; new price valid from 2026-12-01.
Option C: unit price EUR 46.49; payment 30 days net; contract term 24 months; new price valid from 2026-12-01.

Each option offers a longer contract term than your proposal. Option C also keeps your preferred payment terms. We look forward to your choice.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Demo Gießerei GmbH: Pump housing PH-100: the foundry wants +8.8 %
messages.body:
Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We appreciate your proposal for a 24-month contract, which provides valuable planning security for both our companies. For our family foundry, such long-term trust rooted in our region means a great deal.

We are pleased to build on your Option C, maintaining the 30-day payment period over the extended 24-month term. In return for this longer commitment, we are prepared to reduce our price to €51.30 per unit, a step that reflects our dedication to our long-standing partnership.

To summarize our Angebot, we offer a price of €51.30 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026. Please note that this offer stays valid for 30 days.

We look forward to continuing our successful cooperation.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

Option A: unit price EUR 47.36; payment 60 days net; contract term 24 months; new price valid from 2026-12-01.
Option B: unit price EUR 45.98; payment 45 days net; contract term 24 months; new price valid from 2026-12-01.
Option C: unit price EUR 47.05; payment 30 days net; contract term 24 months; new price valid from 2026-12-01.

We believe one of these can work well for both companies and look forward to your view.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH
